classificationMethod: Reread the concept decisions against the full question and every alternative after original reconstruction. Validated existing leaf paths; split sleet/condensation, kept chronology and colonial local-government under bounded new subparts, corrected the industrial-revolution defence leaf, and classified tidal energy by tested concept rather than its position in the source paper. Primary placements remain distinct from source identity and answer verification.
